variables.name: color/surface/primary
variables.description: The baseline container. Used for high-level structural components like main content sheets,  and primary views. It serves as the standard canvas for the application’s core functional areas

variables.name: color/surface/subtle
variables.description: The contextual divider. Used to signal a shift in environment or to partition secondary content. Apply this when moving into sub-sections like Settings, sidebars, or nested views where a visual layering helps the user understand they are in a different branch of the app

variables.name: color/foreground/primary
variables.description: The default color for high importance text, including headings, titles, and primary body copy. Designed for maximum legibility against all standard surfaces.

variables.name: color/border/primary
variables.description: The Structural Standard. Provides clear definition for cards, input fields, and main content containers. It ensures elements are distinct without creating excessive visual noise.

variables.name: color/foreground/secondary
variables.description: Used for supporting text such as captions, metadata, and labels. It reduces visual density to help users scan information quickly.

variables.name: color/foreground/disabled
variables.description: Indicates non-interactive content. It strips the visual weight from labels and icons to show they are currently unavailable for user input.

variables.name: color/foreground/inverse
variables.description: Applied exclusively to dark or brand-colored backgrounds. Essential for maintaining contrast on Brand background, Surface Inverse, and any   surface requiring negative contrast polarity

variables.name: surface/section
variables.description: Background for content sections sitting on the page.

variables.name: foreground/inverse
variables.description: Text/icon color for use on inverse/dark surfaces.

variables.name: border/default
variables.description: Standard border color for containers and dividers.
